sourceCounts.excludedRows: Burst Tier is excluded from items because parent review approved it as copy or FAQ caveat only.

notes: Rows are limited to the three confirmed playable fruit stages: Lemon, Orange, and Lime.
Burst Tier is intentionally not included as an item row because it is locked/future content with no confirmed playable fruit name, requirement, multiplier, or release date.
Orange and Lime requirements use broad player-facing wording because exact threshold screenshots were not available in this phase.
No acceptable direct stage screenshots were found in the research pass, so row image fields stay empty.
unresolvedGaps: Exact Lemon to Orange requirement needs direct current in-game UI verification.
Exact Orange to Lime requirement needs direct current in-game UI verification.
All three rows need clean direct screenshots if image cards are required.

items.name: Lemon
items.cardSummary: Lemon is the baseline fruit stage. Use it to build the first economy, learn the reset loop, and prepare for the first real Evolution choice.
items.multiplierEffect: Base fruit stage before Evolution multipliers
items.incomeSourceNaming: Lemon Stand, LemonDash, Lemon Depot, Lemon Trading, Lemon Labs, Lemon Robotics, Lemon Republic, and Lemon or Orange X naming before later theme changes
items.investorResetImpact: Investors build during normal Ascend/Rebirth progress; no Evolution reset happens before this starting stage
items.sourceStatus: official game theme and fan-system source verified
items.imageStatus: No clean direct stage screenshot saved

items.name: Orange
items.cardSummary: Orange is the first evolved fruit theme. It is the point where the speed boost has to be weighed against losing your current Investor count.
items.requirement: First Evolution after deep investment progress
items.incomeSourceNaming: Orange Stand, Orange Dash, Orange Depot, Orange Trading, Orange Labs, Orange Robotics, Orange Republic, and Orange X
items.investorResetImpact: Evolution resets Investor count, so the 42x jump should be weighed against the Investor bonus being lost
items.sourceStatus: stage and effect source verified; threshold approximate
items.imageStatus: No clean direct stage screenshot saved

items.name: Lime
items.cardSummary: Lime is the later tracked fruit theme. It belongs to deeper runs where Investor progress, Ascend timing, and Evolution speed all matter together.
items.requirement: Later Evolution stage after Orange and deep investor progress
items.incomeSourceNaming: Lime-themed versions of the same Stand, Dash, Depot, Trading, Labs, Robotics, Republic, and X source ladder
items.investorResetImpact: Evolution still resets Investor count; push enough Investor progress before committing to the stage jump
items.sourceStatus: stage and effect source verified; threshold approximate
items.imageStatus: No clean direct stage screenshot saved
